title: Acute respiratory deterioration
banner: DRAFT, NOT clinically reviewed. Fictional scenario specification; never imported, published or shown to learners.
learning_objectives: Escalate a rising oxygen requirement early.
Know that oxygen is titrated within an ordered range.

expected_actions.text: Titrate oxygen only within the order or protocol and record each change with the reason.
Escalate a rising requirement or falling saturation early rather than only turning the oxygen up.
